jobs.description:
Be part of our team!

 

AT&S is a leading global manufacturer of high-end IC substrates and printed circuit boards. AT&S develops and produces leading-edge interconnect technologies for key digital industries: mobile devices, automotive & aerospace, industrial, medical and high-performance computing for AI applications. With production sites in Austria (Leoben, Fehring), China (Shanghai, Chongqing), Malaysia (Kulim), India (Nanjangud) and a European competence center for R&D and IC substrate production in Leoben, AT&S is actively shaping the digital transformation - through forward-looking investments in research and development and the responsible use of resources.

 

To enhance our successful Production Engineering Team at the Headquarters in Leoben, Austria, we are lo... 1 Junior Engineer Production (f/m/d) In this role, you are more than just a link in the chain - you are the catalyst that connects our machine operators with engineering know-how and cross-functional expertise to enable world-class production at Europe's only IC substrate plant.

 

Your Responsibilities

 

 * Act as the vital link between our machine operators and the broader organization - you translate technical complexity into hands-on excellence and bring production insights to life
 * Empower shift leaders and operators through impactful, practice-oriented training - always up-to-date, always close to the real challenges on the shopfloor
 * Shape the future of production stability by supporting smart maintenance strategies - gathering machine data and translating it into actionable improvements
 * Be part of machine change approvals and restarts - together with quality, maintenance and process experts, you make sure we start stronger than before
 * Drive progress - through continuous process improvements and cost-saving ideas, you help stabilize and evolve how we contribute to building some of the world's most advanced technologies
 * Fuel the unique spirit of our Austrian high-tech site - where innovation meets hands-on production, and where we are proud to be the only company in Europe manufacturing IC substrates

 

Your Profile

 

 * Technical education (e.g. HTL), ideally with first experience in the electronics industry or relevant experience with complex machines and their maintenance
 * Proficiency in German and English, strong communication skills, and attention to detail
 * Ability to troubleshoot, analyze data, and support cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment
 * Willingness to work in shift models and cleanroom environment
 * Basic IT skills (Word, Excel)
 * Flexibility, adaptability, and readiness to work in a multicultural team 

 

Our Offer

 

 * A meaningful role with opportunities for long-term growth in an international environment 
 * Chance to actively contribute to AT&S' success and to create value 
 * A structured and tailor-made onboarding program along with continual training opportunities

 

We also offer

 

 * Modern company canteen with freshly prepared meals every day
 * Free parking spaces and e-charging stations
 * Diverse health measures and a wide range of employee benefits

 

Ready for a new challenge to advance your career? It's just a click to apply online. We look forward to your application and your detailed resume. Your AT&S Team!

jobs.occupation: R&D Group Leader for Vision & Web-Technologies (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About Us

ETM professional control GmbH is a 100% subsidiary of Siemens AG, headquartered in Eisenstadt with an additional location in Linz, Austria. We develop the SCADA system SIMATIC WinCC Open Architecture, part of the SIMATIC HMI portfolio, designed for applications requiring a high degree of customer-specific adaptability, large and complex applications, and projects with specific system requirements and functions.

Our solutions are used worldwide i... 1 R&D Group Leader for Vision & Web-Technologies (f/m/x) Your Area of Responsibility

 * Overall responsibility for the output of your team and the product features within the areas of competence covered by the team members
 * Planning personnel, resources, and priorities within the group, including monitoring and verification of effort booking for correctness and completeness
 * Providing the appropriate project accounts
 * Disciplinary management, including:
 * 
 ** Vacation planning and preparation for approval by department management
 ** Conducting employee appraisals
 ** Supporting job interviews
 ** Acting as motivator and first point of contact in case of problems
 * Continuous guidance, coaching, and support of team members
 * Negotiating feature backlogs and prioritization with stakeholders
 * Managing suppliers providing software components and/or tools related to the group's area of competence

Requirements

Must Have

 * Knowledge of software development processes and agile methods
 * Basic programming knowledge in at least one object-oriented programming language or one modern web programming/scripting language (e.g. TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP)
 * Solid MS Office skills
 * Moderation techniques
 * Leadership and teamwork skills
 * Strong organizational and time management skills
 * Stress resistance and ability to improvise
 * High affinity for user experience and modern visualization design across different devices and device types, including mobile devices
 * Structured and team-oriented way of working
 * Degree from a Higher Technical Education Institute, University of Applied Sciences, or Technical University in Automation Technology or Information Technology
 * Advanced German and English language skills, both written and spoken

Nice to Have

 * 2 to 3 years of experience with programming and scripting languages such as TypeScript, JavaScript, C++, or frontend technologies including HTML, XML, JSON, and CSS
 * 2 to 3 years of experience leading a software development team in the SCADA industry
 * Experience with WinCC OA
 * Basic knowledge of web technologies and web architectures
 * Experience in high-quality UI design and user experience

What We Offer

 * State-of-the-art agile working environment within a globally active technology group
 * Opportunity to actively shape the digital transformation in industry
 * Employment with a company repeatedly recognized as one of Austria's Leading Companies
 * Flexible working hours, home office options, mobile working, and continuous training opportunities
 * Free participation in the company fitness program, with 50% of the training time counted as working time
 * Ergonomically designed workstations with height-adjustable desks
 * Company pension scheme in addition to the agreed salary
 * Free charging infrastructure for electric vehicles
 * Company (e-)bike model
 * Company mobile phone with permission for private use
 * Numerous Siemens employee discounts
 * Meal allowance
 * Free hot and cold beverages
